keyPoints: Tribhuj ke teenon konon ka yog 180 hota hai — do kon 60 aur 70 hon to teesra 180 - 130 = 50.
Bahya kon (exterior angle) apne door ke dono antar konon ke yog ke barabar hota hai.
Tribhuj asamanata: kisi bhi do bhujaon ka yog teesri bhuja se bada hona chahiye, warna tribhuj banega hi nahi.
Samkon tribhuj me Pythagoras: karn^2 = lamb^2 + aadhar^2 — 3, 4, 5 iska sabse prasiddh udaharan hai.
Madhyika (median) sheersh ko saamne ki bhuja ke madhya bindu se jodti hai; unnat (altitude) sheersh se bhuja par lamb hota hai — har tribhuj me teen madhyikaen aur teen unnat hote hain.
Samadvibahu tribhuj me barabar bhujaon ke saamne ke kon barabar hote hain — isliye samabahu tribhuj ke teenon kon 60-60 ke hote hain.
Aam galti: bahya kon ko uske paas wale antar kon me jodna — bahya kon door wale do konon ke yog ke barabar hota hai, paas wale ke nahi.
